raw_segments.text: And so they are blamed, whosoever in spite of reason are mastered by, that is pursue
any object, though in its nature noble and good.
They, for instance, who are more earnest than they should be respecting honor or their children
or parents, not but what these are good objects and men are praised for being earnest about
them, but still they admit of excess.
For instance, if anyone, as Niobe did, should fight even against the gods, or feel towards
his father as Satterus, who got there from the nickname of Phi Yoda Lambda Omicron Pi
Alpha Tau Omega Rho, because he was thought to be very foolish.
